private company.

Nigeria (Section 18(3) CAMA).
• Section 19 (1): where a business consists of more than 20 persons, they are

Nigerian law (except in the case of cooperative societies, partnership of
legal professionals, or partnership of accounting professionals).

Common Traditional Software Life Cycle Models
Waterfall Model:
Oldest and most linear SDLC model. It follows a sequential flow, where each phase (requirements → design → implementation → testing → deployment → maintenance) must be completed before the next begins.
V-Model (Verification and Validation Model)
An extension of the Waterfall model, the V-Model emphasizes testing at every development stage. Each development phase corresponds to a testing phase, forming a “V” shape.
Incremental Model
In the Incremental model, the system is built in small functional increments. Each increment adds more features until the full system is completed.
